newsitem.title: UK: Conde Nast and Nikkei to launch VOGUE in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Conde Nast and Nikkei to launch VOGUE in Japan.

text.p: Japanese publisher Nihon Keizai Shimbun (Nikkei) and Conde Nast Publications will launch a Japanese edition of fashion magazine VOGUE, Conde Nast said on Tuesday.
The two have formed a joint venture for the launch and the first Japanese edition of the glossy women's fashion magazine will be published next March.
The Japanese launch continues Conde Nast's strategy of expanding in the Asia-Pacific area.
VOGUE, published in 19 countries, began a Korean edition last year and also publishes in Taiwan. Its men's magazine GQ is available in both Taiwan and Japan.

"I am very pleased to be associated with a publisher of the calibre of Nikkei and I am confident that together we will produce a great edition of VOGUE in Japan," said SI Newhouse Jr, Conde Nast chairman.
Nikkei is one of Japan's top publishers, its titles including leading financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun.
Conde Nast, which has 49 titles worldwide, is privately owned by the American Newshouse family through their Advance Publications Inc unit.
